name: repo-context-verifier
description: Local Codex control bridge with persistent semantic repo memory, process governance, artifact-aware stopping, and evidence-based completion.

interface.shortDescription: Semantic repo memory plus build and verification governance
interface.longDescription: Local MCP bridge that persistently indexes repository symbols and references, bounds context and command output, recognizes completed build artifacts, limits asynchronous deployment polling, and refuses full completion until required evidence is recorded.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Repo Context Verifier to govern this repository task from bounded orientation through direct verification, then stop when the required deliverables are complete.
